guard: normal Manager.stop does not release manager authority until every managed AgentHandle has authoritatively exited
why: The deterministic shutdown cell gives both target seats a runtime exit witness and asserts stop proves both exits before returning.
A second cell makes one runtime stop throw and its wait report still-running; shutdown must fail loud rather than release authority into an orphan window.

mutations.name: release manager authority immediately after requesting seat stops
mutations.expectRed: shutdown: stop() proves every managed child exited before releasing manager authority
mutations.cell: shutdown: stop() proves every managed child exited before releasing manager authority
